locations.label: Hub Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Pack-a-Punch is already in Stalingrad’s starting hub. Its upgrade tiers cost 7,500, 15,000 and 30,000 Essence. Ammo-mod effects come through Covenants rather than a Pack-a-Punch ammo-mod menu. These are Vanguard’s source-documented prices, not Cold War’s price schedule. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Altar of Covenants
locations.description: Use Sacrificial Hearts at the Altar of Covenants for available combat effects or at the Tome of Rituals to strengthen your artifact. Covenants refresh after objectives and become stronger at later rarity; inspect the actual offers. Brain Rot supplies temporary allies, melee bonuses help close fighting, and damage/reload bonuses suit different weapons. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Hub crafting table
locations.description: Collect the single green salvage type and use the crafting table for armour, equipment and support. Repair armour before another portal or Void session. A Heart, salvage and Essence are different resources; buying a Covenant does not upgrade your weapon. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Office Void portal
locations.description: Use the Void portal inside Von List’s Office. Survive three full rounds in its Shi No Numa area. This opens the return portal near Flinger Gate; you may stay for further survival, but take the return portal for the narrative route. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Apartments rune stone
locations.description: Complete the remaining portal objectives needed to open Apartments. On its top floor, find the room with a floor ritual and interact with the rune stone. Wait for the conversation and Krafft’s cue about Command Post. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Krafft door / green portal
locations.description: Go back up Command Post’s stairs and interact with the white door bearing the magical symbol. Let Krafft and the Dark Aether entities finish their conversation. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
